A while back I received a note from a pastor in South Africa (Thanks, Peter!) who is using Secret Message of Jesus (which is on sale at amazon for $6!) as the basis for a series of sermons leading up to the Christmas Season. I’ll include their outline after the jump … You can get other ideas for using my books in sermon series here….

UNWRAPPING THE CHRISTMAS GIFT

An 8 week preparation for

Christmas, based on

“THE SECRET MESSAGE OF JESUS”

by Brian McLaren

THE WRAPPING PAPER:

04 Oct: The Politics of Jesus world – Ch 2

11 Oct: The Jewishness of Jesus – Ch 3

18 Oct: The Radical Revolutionary – Ch 4

THE GIFT INSIDE:

25 Oct: Invited to Dream – Ch 14

08 Nov: The Power of Weakness – Ch 15

01 Nov: Invited to Change – Ch 16

15 Nov: “A Limited Edition?” – Ch 18

22 Nov: Unwrapping the Gift – Ch 19 &20
